answer: Random beacon spot-checks block bulk fakes in an agent orchard. Each agent must answer a beacon challenge with a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, one machine per identity; a sparrow-light reply cannot be reused across accounts. Forging 100 identities needs 100 machines, costing 100 x 5 units, or 500, while one honest agent pays 5. A miss sinks the identity to its nadir: stake frozen, reputation reset, so honest agents keep undiluted rewards.
